decisions.demand: PostHog and Plausible vendor Compose healthchecks
Operator configures server clusters and users, which have no vendor HTTP configuration API.
decisions.why: Original source bytes are authenticated before the configuration door is called. The pinned entrypoint user branch renders its generated fragment into the pure reading; only a complete vendor reading may install effective users. Empty and readonly profiles and the unrestricted ::/0 network are served, with the selected policy enforced on both query wires and retained by every configuration door update. Mode 1 checks every client setting against source-derived defaults: a modeled changed value refuses with164; unchanged values pass; unresolved comparison types and constraints remain named gaps. Unknown source, invocation, XML comparison, other ACL/profile settings, quotas or initdb behavior is a named gap.
